name: Kingdom of Luang Phrabang
description: A red field charged with a white three-headed elephant standing on a stepped pedestal beneath a parasol.
history: Flag of the Kingdom of Luang Phrabang, the successor of Lan Xang that became the French protectorate of Laos; its elephant flag continued as the royal Lao flag until 1975.

features.role: three-headed elephant on pedestal beneath parasol
